headings.strategy: Keep Barlow Condensed for large marketing headings (H1, H2) to retain the industrial/logistics brand feel, but use it with tight tracking. For dashboard headings where readability is key, switch to Inter with medium/semibold weight.

body.strategy: Use Inter for all body text, dashboard labels, and UI elements. Ensure high contrast against backgrounds.

mono.strategy: Use strictly for tracking numbers, dates, times, and technical data in tables/timeline.

visual_enhancers.radius: Transition from 0px (sharp) to rounded-xl (12px) for large containers and rounded-lg (8px) for buttons/inputs. This softens the brutalist look into a premium Stripe/Linear aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use very subtle, diffused shadows. shadow-[0_2px_8px_-2px_rgba(15,23,42,0.08)] for cards. Avoid harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 on all white surfaces (cards, tables) on a slate-50 background.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Buttons should lift slightly (-translate-y-[1px]) and increase shadow. Table rows should use hover:bg-slate-50/80.

kpi_cards.classes: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-2 relative overflow-hidden
kpi_cards.details: Include a subtle top-right icon container (e.g., bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 p-2 rounded-lg). Use Barlow Condensed for the main numeric value (text-4xl). Add a micro-trend indicator (e.g., +5% this week in green).

charts_container.classes: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-6 shadow-sm
charts_container.details: Use Recharts with custom tooltips that match the UI (white bg, rounded-lg, shadow-md). Grid lines should be stroke-slate-100. Lines/Bars should use orange-600 and slate-900.

data_table.header: bg-slate-50 border-y border-slate-200 text-slate-500 font-medium py-3 px-4

status_badges.classes: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

timeline.dot_active: absolute -left-[31px] w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-orange-600 ring-4 ring-orange-50
timeline.dot_inactive: absolute -left-[31px] w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-300 ring-4 ring-white
timeline.title: font-medium text-slate-900

buttons.primary: bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all shadow-sm

inputs.classes: w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-600/20 focus:border-orange-600 transition-all outline-none

landing_hero.details: Use a dark theme for the hero to make it feel premium. Add a subtle radial gradient mesh in the background or a heavily darkened image overlay (bg-slate-900/80). High contrast CTA in orange. Large Barlow Condensed typography.

layouts.dashboard: Sidebar on the left (w-64 bg-slate-900 text-white) + Topbar (bg-white border-b) + Main Content area (bg-slate-50 p-8).
layouts.public_pages: Sticky Header (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b) + Main Content + Fat Footer (bg-slate-900 py-16).

motion.micro_interactions: Add scale-[0.98] active states to buttons. Use framer-motion (or simple CSS classes) for staggering list items in the timeline.
motion.page_transitions: Fade-in main content sections on mount.

hero_background.description: Stunning silhouette of a cargo ship during a vibrant sunset

warehouse_section.description: Bright modern warehouse featuring pallets and storage racks

delivery_action.description: Close-up of hands exchanging cardboard boxes indoors

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT build from scratch. Preserve existing routing, architecture, and backend integration.
Apply the styling guidelines to existing components and views.
Transform the UI from 'sharp brutalist' to 'Stripe-like premium' by adding rounded-lg/xl, subtle shadows, and off-white backgrounds (slate-50).
Implement the 17-status parcel timeline exactly as defined in the timeline component specs, using JetBrains Mono for timestamps.
Ensure the Send Parcel form retains the HARDCODED Italy Hub address visually intact.
Build the dashboard using a layout with a dark sidebar (slate-900) and light main content area (slate-50).
Do not use totally transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where applicable.
Do not center align app container text globally.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
